# ghost/mancala

Mancala (F-Droid): start a Kalah game, play pits for each player in turn, read the board, stores and winner. The whole game is a readable text console. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/mancala
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/mancala new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/mancala move --device <serial> --param pit=<pit>
ghost skill run ghost/mancala play_moves --device <serial> --param pits=<pits>
ghost skill run ghost/mancala get_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a Mancala game
- `move`: Play pit 3 in Mancala
- `play_moves`: Play pits 3, 1 and 5 in Mancala
- `get_state`: What does the Mancala board look like?
